info.name: EDealer API
info.description: Multi-tenant SaaS API for vehicle dealers and RTO agents. Base URL uses {{baseUrl}}/api/v1.

Create a new user. Sends 6-digit signup OTP to email. No access JWT until verify-otp (SIGNUP_EMAIL_VERIFICATION).

Authenticate with email and password. Returns user (dealerId from DealerWiseUser) and JWT. Exchange a valid refresh token for a new access token + rotated refresh token. No Authorization header. 4017 when the refresh token is invalid/expired/wrong-purpose.
Verify 6-digit OTP from email after register. Returns access JWT and user.

Re-send OTP. purpose: SIGNUP_EMAIL_VERIFICATION or PASSWORD_RESET.
Request password reset OTP (generic success message).
Set new password using Bearer resetToken from verify-otp (PASSWORD_RESET). Expires per JWT_PASSWORD_RESET_EXPIRES_IN.

Get WebAuthn authentication options for passkey login. No auth required. Use response options in navigator.credentials.get(), then call Passkey Login Verify with the credential.

Dual-persona: persona read from the token (agent token -> agent side, dealer token -> dealer side). Lists the caller's khata accounts (dealer -> one per agent; agent -> one per dealer), newest-updated first. Each account has a signed dealer-perspective balance (balance > 0 => dealer owes agent) plus a counterparty summary. 4059 if the token is not a dealer/agent account.

Running-balance statement for one dealer<->agent pair. counterpartyId is the agent id (dealer caller) or the dealer id (agent caller). data = { account|null, entries (newest first by seq), meta }. Reads do NOT require an active grant. 4220 if counterpartyId is not a UUID.

Post a credit/debit entry to the pair (caller + counterparty). Sign convention (dealer-perspective): CREDIT raises what the dealer owes the agent (+amount), DEBIT lowers it. direction is CREDIT|DEBIT; amount > 0, <= 2 decimal places. description and assignmentId optional. Requires an ACTIVE dealer<->agent grant (else 4054); an agent's placeholder dealer must be connected first (else 4057). Captures ledgerEntryId from the response.

Reverse an entry the caller is a party to: posts an opposite-direction counter-entry (originals are never hard-deleted) and stamps the original isReversed: true. data.entry is the reversal (reversesEntryId set). 4037 not a party, 4055 already reversed, 4056 cannot reverse a reversal, 4054 no active grant.

Post a balancing entry that drives the pair's balance toward zero. Send amount for a partial settle (capped at the outstanding balance); omit amount (send {} or no body) for a full settle. Requires an ACTIVE grant (4054). 4058 if already settled (balance is zero).
Upload a single image and extract readable text as strict JSON using Gemini.
Upload a single ID proof image (Aadhaar, PAN, DL, etc.). Returns fullName, address, city, state, pincode.
